mapper.sql: id, exception_type, recon_layer, blocking, source_type, source_id, statement_id, clearing_account_id, cash_account_id, entity_type, entity_id, currency, difference_amount, detail, status, active_slot, opened_by, opened_time, closed_time, version, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_recon_exception WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND source_id = #{sourceId} AND exception_type = #{exceptionType} AND active_slot = 1
SELECT FROM t_recon_exception WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND exception_type = #{exceptionType} AND active_slot = 1 AND source_id IN #{sourceId} ORDER BY id

SELECT FROM ( SELECT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY opened_time DESC, id DESC) AS rn FROM t_recon_exception WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND exception_type = #{exceptionType} AND source_id IN #{sourceId} ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM t_recon_exception WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND source_id = #{sourceId} AND active_slot = 1 ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM t_recon_exception WHERE statement_id = #{statementId} AND active_slot = 1 ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM t_recon_exception ORDER BY opened_time, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) AS exception_count, SUM(blocking) AS blocking_count FROM ( SELECT blocking, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, opened_time, #{now}) <= 3 THEN 'D0_3' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, opened_time, #{now}) <= 7 THEN 'D4_7' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, opened_time, #{now}) <= 30 THEN 'D8_30' ELSE 'D31_PLUS' END AS bucket FROM t_recon_exception WHERE active_slot = 1 AND currency = #{currency} AND entity_type = 'OPERATING_ENTITY' AND entity_id = #{entityNo} ) aged GROUP BY bucket
